aboutHeading: Decades of Outdoor Experience in Mickleham
aboutText: Sky Nature has been serving Mickleham and the greater Melbourne region for decades, delivering high-quality fencing, custom decking, and professional mowing services. Our team takes pride in providing eco-friendly solutions tailored to every property, from residential homes to large acreage estates. We guarantee customer satisfaction, timely service, and the best value for your money on every project.
servicesText: From Colourbond fencing and Merbau decking to full-scale lawn maintenance, Sky Nature delivers reliable, professional outdoor services across Mickleham and Melbourne's northern suburbs.

services.title: Fencing Services
services.desc: Colourbond, wood, chain link, bamboo and boundary fencing — built to last across Mickleham and Melbourne.

services.title: Decking Services
services.desc: Merbau, composite, concrete and pool decking installed with precision for lasting outdoor living spaces.

services.title: Lawn Mowing
services.desc: Regular lawn mowing, grass slashing and acreage ride-on mowing to keep your Mickleham property looking sharp.

services.title: Garden Landscaping
services.desc: Complete garden design, hedge trimming, pruning and planting to transform your outdoor areas.

services.title: Property Maintenance
services.desc: Gutter cleaning, rubbish removal, garden upkeep and commercial contract gardening across Victoria.

services.title: Fence & Gate Installations
services.desc: Gate installations, fence repairs, insurance fencing and housing estate fencing with hassle-free service.

reviews.text: Sky Nature replaced our entire boundary fencing at our Mickleham home. The team was punctual, professional and the Colourbond fence looks fantastic. Customer satisfaction really is guaranteed with these guys.

reviews.text: We hired Sky Nature for composite decking at our café in Melbourne's north. Outstanding workmanship, great communication throughout and they finished ahead of schedule. Best value for money we have found.
reviews.name: David Nguyen

reviews.text: Sky Nature handles all our mowing and garden maintenance across multiple properties in the area. Reliable, eco-friendly and always on time. Their acreage ride-on mowing service is second to none.
